<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';
wp_set_current_user(1);
// Photos from Widows Sons Grand Chapter Bulgaria's 2025 National Tour.
$titles = array(
  'tour-01-group-service-station.jpg' => 'National Tour 2025: the group at the start',
  'tour-02-church-blessing.jpg'       => 'National Tour 2025: blessing at the monastery',
  'tour-03-evening-dinner.jpg'        => 'National Tour 2025: evening gathering',
  'tour-04-three-men-bar.jpg'         => 'National Tour 2025: with friends on the road',
);
$ids = array();
$up = wp_upload_dir();
foreach ($titles as $file => $title) {
  $src = '/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/ws-demo-media/' . $file;
  if (!file_exists($src) || filesize($src) < 1000) continue;
  $dest = $up['path'] . '/' . $file;
  rename($src, $dest);
  $id = wp_insert_attachment(array('post_mime_type'=>'image/jpeg','post_title'=>$title,'post_status'=>'inherit'), $dest);
  wp_update_attachment_metadata($id, wp_generate_attachment_metadata($id, $dest));
  update_post_meta($id, '_wp_attachment_image_alt', $title);
  $ids[$file] = $id;
}
if (!$ids) return;
$g = function ($f) use ($ids) { return $ids[$f] ?? 0; };
// Home hero = Home page featured image.
set_post_thumbnail((int) get_option('page_on_front'), $g('tour-01-group-service-station.jpg'));
// Bulgaria: country header photo, chapter header photo, galleries.
$bg = (int) term_exists('Bulgaria', 'ws_country')['term_id'];
update_term_meta($bg, 'hero_image', $g('tour-02-church-blessing.jpg'));
update_term_meta($bg, 'gallery', implode(',', array_values($ids)));
$ch = get_page_by_path('bulgaria', OBJECT, 'ws_chapter');
if ($ch) {
  set_post_thumbnail($ch->ID, $g('tour-04-three-men-bar.jpg'));
  update_post_meta($ch->ID, 'gallery', implode(',', array_values($ids)));
}
// Featured images on the sample news.
$news = get_posts(array('post_type'=>'post','numberposts'=>3,'orderby'=>'date','order'=>'DESC'));
foreach ($news as $i => $n) {
  set_post_thumbnail($n->ID, array_values($ids)[$i % count($ids)]);
}
